app.title: BooruFlow
home.subtitle: Search, review, organize and maintain Booru metadata from one workspace.
home.review: Find and review tags by category or text list.
home.tagging: Inspect under-tagged posts without automatic submission.
home.organization: Maintain the local tag taxonomy and its sources.
home.cleanup: Audit existing folders before recoverable cleanup.
home.options: Configure sites, databases, language and credentials.
home.grabber: Generate and resume Grabber batches when the optional tool is available.
page.review: Category review and TXT-list review will be consolidated here.
page.tagging: Manual browser-assisted tagging review will be migrated here.
page.organization: Taxonomy browsing, editing and source updates will live here.
page.cleanup: Folder drop, audit progress and recoverable actions will live here.
page.grabber: This section is optional. The rest of BooruFlow remains usable without Grabber.
options.note: Credentials are stored only in the local config folder and are excluded from Git.
review.queries: One search per line (semicolon also accepted):
review.example: Example: with {total} total results, {percent}% requires at least {required} matching result(s).
review.interrupted: Review stopped or failed. See the log.
review.count_gelbooru_only: Pre-scan counting is currently available for Gelbooru.
review.credentials_missing: Gelbooru credentials are missing. Add them in Options.
